events.verdict: Replay review of the foul called on Washington (DAL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Although Washington makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it, Lively II (DAL) continues moving forwards into Sharpe's (POR) space and dislodges him from his position. The foul is assessed to Lively II instead of Washington.
Grimes (DAL) legally contests Simons's (POR) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Sharpe (POR) drops the ball while in the air and is the first player to touch it.
Grimes (DAL) continues moving forwards into Camara (POR), delivering contact during the screen.
Lively II (DAL) moves laterally into Camara (POR), initiating body contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Simons (POR) contests Dinwiddie's (DAL) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Simons (POR) initiates illegal contact with Grimes (DAL) that affects his SQBR during the driving shot attempt.
Sharpe (POR) commits a take foul on Dinwiddie (DAL).
Grimes (DAL) contests Simons' (POR) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
